items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That was Remus... [INTERVIEWEE] And he was a good drummer, too.

ctx.x: Well, they had four of them, and all of them was drummers.
And one of them worked on the boat, and I didn't even know it. That was Remus. Remus, yeah. I guess I saw him a lot of times, didn't even know it.
And he was a good drummer, too.
